profile: Ocugen develops gene therapies for blindness-causing diseases using its modifier gene therapy platform. Its late-stage programs include OCU400 for retinitis pigmentosa, with Phase 3 liMeliGhT data expected in 2027; OCU410ST for Stargardt disease, in a Phase 2/3 pivotal trial; and OCU410 for geographic atrophy, now in Phase 3. The company also works with regional partners to expand potential patient access to OCU400.
